register_tool: register a new MCP tool with a name, description, input schema, and handler function
get_tool: get a registered MCP tool from the registry by its name
list_tools: list all registered MCP tools, optionally filtering by a name prefix
convert_tools_to_mcp_sdk_tool_type: convert a list of MCPTool objects to MCP SDK Tool type instances
load_tools_from_config: load and register MCP tools from a proxy configuration dictionary
